Since the content of postcards was visible

What differentiates the special postmarks from other paraphernalia from and about

Christmas markets is that they were authorized by the Government-owned postal service

and not merely by the local community or the event organizers. Some of the special cancels

were applied to stamps afﬁxed on black envelopes of postcards (cancelled to order), while

others were afﬁxed to standard items sent through the mail. From the perspective of the

host, these represent advertising of the event and its continuity. By virtue of a special

at the time would not have been lost as most people would have been past or present
